title: Pure Bartholomeus per-node derived-cache algebra
protocol: PIN_B1_11 -> EXPLICIT_SAMPLED_INPUTS -> PURE_CACHE_ALGEBRA -> SOURCE_FORMULA_ORACLE -> O0_O2_REPLAY -> HOLD_CACHE_LIFECYCLE

source.source_inputs: Sampled watcon values at campbell_h100, campbell_h500 and gfp_h100, plus cofgen terms and Campbell thresholds; the pure algebra receives those sampled values explicitly

scope: per-node pure algebra for Campbell b, gfp100, d_soil_term1, d_soil_term2, Capac_term, Nmin1 and Mplus1
preserve source expression and left-to-right arithmetic order
explicit arguments only; no hidden or retained cache
non_goals: cache ownership, construction key, invalidation or multi-run lifecycle
O2_pars, c_top profile buffer, OxygenStress/MICRO/MACRO/SOLVE runtime binding
SWAP-007 solver integration or solver policy change
pass_conditions: 100,000 deterministic physically ordinary sampled-input vectors bitwise match the explicit B1.11 formula oracle
malformed/non-finite and singular sampled inputs fail closed
production runtime and state owners remain unchanged
